name: Wireless Earbuds Pro X1
description: The Pro X1 delivers premium sound at a fraction of the brand-name price. Active Noise Cancellation blocks up to 25dB, dual-driver technology produces crisp highs and punchy bass, and the charging case extends total playtime to 30 hours. IPX5 water resistance means sweat and rain are no concern. Touch controls on each earbud let you manage calls, music, and your assistant without touching your phone.
shortDesc: True wireless earbuds with ANC, 30h battery and IPX5 waterproofing.
features: 30 hours total battery with charging case
pros: Exceptional ANC for the price point
Multipoint connects to 2 devices simultaneously
IPX5 — safe for workouts and light rain
Quick charge: 10 min gives 1.5h playback
Comfortable fit with 3 ear tip sizes included
cons: Ambient sound mode sounds slightly artificial
App is basic compared to premium brands

reviews.name: Andres M.
reviews.text: Sound quality rivals my old $120 earbuds. ANC is legitimately good — blocks out my open office completely.

reviews.name: Sofia R.
reviews.text: Great value. Fit is comfortable and they stay in during runs. Wish the case had wireless charging but at this price it's hard to complain.

reviews.name: James K.
reviews.text: Bought these skeptically. Immediately returned my $90 pair. These just sound better.

name: Compact TKL Mechanical Keyboard
description: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard built for typists and gamers who demand feel without breaking the bank. Hot-swappable PCB lets you change switches without soldering. Pre-lubed stabilizers eliminate rattle out of the box. Gasket-mounted design gives a slight bounce that reduces typing fatigue on long sessions. Full per-key RGB with 18 built-in effects.
shortDesc: TKL layout, hot-swappable switches, RGB backlight, USB-C.
features: Hot-swappable PCB — change switches without soldering
Gasket mount reduces harsh typing feel
Pre-lubed stabilizers, rattle-free from day one
pros: Hot-swap socket — change switches in seconds, no soldering
PBT keycaps resist shine and feel premium
Gasket mount reduces harsh typing feel
Pre-lubed stabs are rattle-free from day one
USB-C is modern and cable is replaceable
cons: RGB bleeds slightly at keycap edges

reviews.name: Carlos V.
reviews.text: Swapped to Boba U4 tactiles and this board feels incredible. Hot-swap is a game changer at this price.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: Great for the office. Quieter than expected with the stock reds. Build quality is surprisingly solid.

reviews.name: Lucas T.
reviews.text: PBT caps, hot-swap, gasket mount — I was paying 3x this price for all three features. Done.

name: 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
description: Turns a single USB-C port into a full workstation. The 4K@60Hz HDMI output handles any modern monitor. 100W Power Delivery pass-through charges your laptop at full speed while you work. Two USB-A 3.0 ports push up to 5Gbps for fast file transfers. Built-in SD and MicroSD card readers support UHS-I for fast photo imports. The aluminum shell dissipates heat and survives daily bag-tossing.
shortDesc: 4K HDMI, 100W PD, SD/MicroSD, 3× USB-A — compact aluminum body.
features: Plug-and-play on Mac, Windows, iPad, ChromeOS
pros: 4K@60Hz HDMI — no resolution compromises
100W PD keeps your laptop fully charged while in use
Aluminum body stays cool even under sustained load
UHS-I card readers are fast enough for RAW photo work
Works plug-and-play on Mac, Windows, and iPad
cons: Fixed cable can't be replaced if damaged
Only one HDMI port — not for dual-monitor setups
USB-A and HDMI share bandwidth under heavy simultaneous use

reviews.name: Mia H.
reviews.text: MacBook Pro user — this replaced a $90 branded hub perfectly. 4K monitor, charging, and SD card all at once with zero issues.

reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.text: Does everything it claims. Runs warm but not hot. Only gripe is the fixed cable.

name: 20,000mAh Power Bank
description: Twenty thousand milliamp-hours of compact, airline-approved power. The 65W USB-C port charges a MacBook Air from flat in just over two hours, and a modern Android flagship in about 45 minutes. A second USB-C at 18W handles phones and earbuds. USB-A supports 22.5W for legacy devices. The slim 15mm profile slips into the same pocket as your phone.
shortDesc: 65W fast charge, dual USB-C + USB-A, charges a MacBook in 2h.
features: 65W USB-C charges a MacBook Air in ~2 hours
Slim 15mm profile — fits in a jeans pocket
pros: True 65W output charges laptops, not just phones
Slim 15mm profile fits in a jeans pocket
All three ports can be used at the same time
Under 100Wh limit — carry-on safe on all airlines
Recharges itself fully in ~1.5h at 65W
cons: Slightly heavy at 360g compared to budget rivals
LED indicator shows quarters, not exact percentage

reviews.name: Elena S.
reviews.text: Charges my M2 MacBook Air as fast as the wall adapter. Traveled with it for 2 weeks — it was the last thing I needed to worry about.

reviews.name: Omar B.
reviews.text: The slimmest 20k bank I've found. Previous one was twice as thick. Huge upgrade for daily carry.

reviews.name: Rachel W.
reviews.text: Works great. Would give 5 stars if it had wireless charging but for this price that's a minor ask.

name: Precision Gaming Mouse
description: Built around the PAW3395 optical sensor — the same sensor found in mice costing three times as much. Zero acceleration and perfect 1:1 tracking at any DPI setting. The honeycomb shell shaves the weight to 60 grams. Six programmable buttons with hardware memory mean your settings follow the mouse to any PC. Ambidextrous shape fits left- and right-handed users.
shortDesc: PAW3395 sensor, 26000 DPI, 6 programmable buttons, 60g ultralight.
pros: PAW3395 sensor is best-in-class — no spin-out, no acceleration
60g weight reduces fatigue during long sessions
Paracord cable feels almost wireless
PTFE feet glide smoothly straight out of the box
Hardware memory stores DPI/macros without software installed
cons: Ambidextrous shape doesn't suit large hands as well as ergonomic options
Side buttons could have more tactile feedback
RGB is subtle — not ideal if you want a light show

reviews.name: Tyler G.
reviews.text: PAW3395 at this price is absurd. Tracking is flawless. My $80 mouse is gathering dust.

reviews.name: Natalia P.
reviews.text: Switched from an ergonomic mouse and love the ambi shape. Light enough that I forget I'm holding it.

reviews.name: David L.
reviews.text: Great sensor, great price. Cable is notably flexible. Minor gripe: side buttons feel a bit plasticky.
